objective_value: <float> Weighted combination of total line cost and total passenger travel time achieved by the solution.

active_lines.line_index: <int> Identifier of this line within the enumerated set of candidate lines.
active_lines.nodes: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of station identifiers visited by this line from one terminal to the other.
active_lines.edges: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of edge identifiers traversed by this line.
active_lines.frequency: <float> Number of vehicle runs per planning period operated on this line.

active_passenger_paths.origin: <int> Origin station identifier of the OD pair carried by this path.
active_passenger_paths.destination: <int> Destination station identifier of the OD pair carried by this path.
active_passenger_paths.arcs: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of directed arc identifiers traversed by this path from origin to destination.
active_passenger_paths.flow: <float> Number of passengers routed along this path. The released certificate requires a non-empty complete path-flow witness so demand, capacity, and passenger travel cost can all be checked exactly.
